notes.title: System of Souls is now available
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43797225/6c426a086e07f0aae719fa5310ea665e54a32c2b.png

System of Souls is now available!

Do souls take up space? Finally, yes. We were eager to say it. And now they can also take up space in your digital storage. Or on your bookshelf. Because the release of System of Souls, the game by Chaotic Lab that explores the very nature of the soul, has arrived. And it comes in two ways: in digital edition for PlayStation 5 and PC, and in physical edition for PS5, brought to you by Selecta Play. Get them on the PlayStation Store, on Steam, and at your favorite physical stores.

[previewyoutube=EiYwfFuIUts;full][/previewyoutube]

And what's waiting for you in System of Souls? A fantastic first-person, puzzle-solving, sci-fi first-person game.
  
The ecological catastrophe of the year 2155 is becoming incompatible with life. For this reason, the company ION is making a fortune as the only one capable of transferring the souls of citizens to synthetic bodies: the androids L-064N. But it turns out that not all of these transfers go well. At least, yours didn't go well: because you don't remember who you are or what you do in this stainless steel world.
 
With this premise in mind you will make your way through the immense ION complex in search of your spirit, which is the same as looking for meaning in your life. So make room for this game in your digital storage, on your bookshelf and, above all, in your soul..

Featured content:

 Now available on PlayStation Store and Steam. 
 Intriguing and immersive narrative.
 Original mechanics: puzzles will surprise you.
 Scenarios with oppressive atmosphere.

notes.title: Add System of Souls to your Wishlist now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43797225/6c426a086e07f0aae719fa5310ea665e54a32c2b.png

System of Souls, only if you have a soul do you have a wish

Think about it, what does wishlist mean? Wishlist, right? Let's go a little further: what wishes can a pot have? Few. Why? Because it has no soul. Good. Well, here we come to talk about a game in which you are going to have to find your soul. The first way to prove that you have a soul is that you have wishes. And since you have wishes, you should add System of Souls to the wishlist that just opened today, both on PlayStation Store (for PS4 y PS5) and Steam.

[previewyoutube=p2tgQaaD-n4;full][/previewyoutube]

Systems of Souls proposes a first-person game mechanics, whose puzzles are solved with only one hand and all your neurons, interacting with the objects that you will find.
  
The game is divided into four parts, the four floors of the ION facility, adding different elements to the gameplay and increasing the difficulty. All with the promise of recovering your original body in the Atkinson-Schiffrin tower.

Do you notice that little warmth that starts at the crown of your head and extends to the tips of your toes? It's the desire to own this game, which can be interpreted as the presence of soul. In other words, if after what you've read you don't feel like adding System of Souls to your wishlist, I'd be worried: if you don't feel any desire, maybe you don't have a soul.
